{"caption":"Workflow diagram showing how an agent system constructs notes, links and evolves stored memories, and retrieves relevant memories for a query.","description":"The diagram is divided into four titled regions: Note Construction, Link Generation, Memory Evolution, and Memory Retrieval. In Note Construction, a globe labeled “Environment” and a robot labeled “LLM Agents” are joined by a two-way arrow labeled “Interaction.” A downward arrow labeled “Write” leads to two example conversation boxes. Conversation 1 asks for help implementing a custom web-application cache supporting memory and disk storage; Conversation 2 says the cache works but memory use is high and asks about implementing an LRU eviction policy. Each conversation points downward to an LLM symbol and then to a blue note icon labeled “Note.” Between the two note-making paths, “Note Attributes” lists Timestamp, Content, Context, Keywords, Tags, and Embedding, with small icons; the embedding is shown as a row of pink blocks. A connector from the right-hand note runs upward and then right into the memory area, with “Retrieve” printed beside its vertical segment.

In Link Generation, a container labeled “Memory” holds four smaller boxes labeled Box 1, Box i, Box j, and Box n, each containing three blue note icons. A downward blue arrow labeled “Top-k” leads to a selected note labeled m_i and a small group of note icons joined by branching, curved connections. A rightward arrow carries this group to an LLM symbol. A downward blue arrow labeled “Store” leads from the group to two boxes labeled Box n+1 and Box n+2, each holding three note icons.

In Memory Evolution, boxes labeled Box n+1 and Box n+2 each contain rows of note icons. A black arrow points downward from this memory-box area toward the lower part of the panel. Below, “Action” appears over a blue downward arrow leading to three note icons; a small evolution-like symbol and the label “Evolve” appear beneath them.

In Memory Retrieval, a magnifying-glass-like symbol is labeled “Query.” The query is associated with “Text Model” and a pink block-row labeled “Query Embedding.” An arrow labeled “Retrieve” points left from the embedding toward the memory side. A separate path labeled “Top-k” runs rightward from the memory area and then downward to a container labeled “Relative Memory,” which holds three note icons; “1st” is printed above the first. A downward arrow from these relative memories leads to a robot labeled “LLM Agents.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
